# Real-face test fixture

`official_portrait_barack_obama.jpg` is the unmodified original of
“Official portrait of Barack Obama,” photographed by **Pete Souza** on
January 13, 2009, for the Obama-Biden Transition Project.

- Image and attribution/license information:
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Official_portrait_of_Barack_Obama.jpg
- Original image:
  https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e9/Official_portrait_of_Barack_Obama.jpg
- Upstream source and copyright policy (archived):
  https://web.archive.org/web/20090204221705/http://change.gov/newsroom/entry/new_official_portrait_released/
  and https://web.archive.org/web/20160921160143/http://change.gov/about/copyright_policy
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0):

- SHA-256: `19ec613e6831dd0c285b907f4cf1be13a654f8ac237435146320ec3dcc42cd45`

Wikimedia Commons identifies this particular pre-inauguration photograph as
CC BY 3.0, not as a U.S. government public-domain work. The test video
resizes and composites the original; it is a modified use, not an endorsement.
